狗咬狗（狗咬狗（第22页）“神官和它们本就是对立的，只要你帮我牵制住它们一段时间，我就能帮你解决掉这些干尸。”庄稼汉沉思许久，摇了摇头。“你想在我面前吃了师弟？”怪物没有否认，反而问了一句：“对你来说，真的重要吗？”比自己活下去的机会都重要？干尸永远不会放过这群道士，它们如影随形，始终藏在暗处寻找机会，尝试夺舍这群从道观里出来的每一个人。怪物说：“你和它们是敌人，我和它们也是敌人，你帮助我就是帮自己。”至于师弟，他注定会死在这座草原上，与其落在干尸口中，不如便宜自己。死道友不死贫道，这个道理应该很容易理解。庄稼汉默默抬起头，似乎想通了。他转身走向道观外，推开大门，迎向了草原上的那两具干尸。怪物露出笑容，张开血盆大口，咬住了少年的魂魄。它也转过身，爬到了石像上。“滴答~滴答~”一股股血水从石像头顶上冒出，如泉眼一般四处流淌，盖住了石像的每一处。地面上的血水越来越浓，越积越多。怪物贴在石像上，渐渐蜕了毛，脱下皮，变成一具干干巴巴的尸体，没了动静。“或早，或晚，终有那么一天。”“或远，或近，她早晚会回来，”道观内回荡着犬吠，石像低声自语：“主人说的没错，她马上就要回来了。”……“哐当~”很突然，道观的大门被一脚踹开。庄稼汉一马当先，又一次冲进了门内，他大喊着：“师弟别怕，师兄又来救你了。”他这次不是一个人，还找了两个救兵。半死不活的石像突然凝固了，慢慢抬起眼皮，看见了一个不知死活的家伙，和门外那两具摩拳擦掌的干尸。狗头神像张开嘴，发出震耳欲聋的声音：“你怎么敢和它们为伍？”“难道你不明白，你们一定会死在它们手里？”“我明白。”庄稼汉耸了耸肩，无所谓的笑了笑：“但师傅就是这么安排的，我这人比较听话。”“况且，我很讨厌别人骗我，狗也不行。”狗头神像反问：“这是何意？”庄稼汉眯起眼睛，质问道：“你到底是什么东西，到底是从哪儿来的？”“吾乃泽国神明，大神官亲自敕封的神官。”“滚你的吧。”庄稼汉咧嘴一笑：“哪儿来的大神官？”“这是我编出来骗师弟的，你还跟我演上了？”狗头神像突然沉默，一言不发。庄稼汉一字一句的说道：“泽国真正的历史，是道观里的这群玩意儿出了叛徒。”“它吃里爬外，贪生怕死，主动给仙人当走狗，招惹来了别的东西。”这条狗在哪儿呢？这条狗是谁呢？此时此刻，应该不难猜吧？狗头神像安静许久，忽然笑了一声。它看着干尸和道士，低声问道：“我是做了狗，但你可知道，做的是谁的狗？”你们清不清楚，狗主人是谁？庄稼汉挑了挑眉，问：“谁？”狗头神像张开口，说了两个字。“山主。”道观忽然安静了，再没有任何声音。许久之后，庄稼汉抬起头，问了一句。“山主，是谁？”师傅没说过，他真不知道。

Dog bites dog (dog bites dog (page 22)) "Priests and them are inherently antagonistic. As long as you help me contain them for a while, I can help you get rid of these mummies." The farmer pondered for a long time and shook his head. "You want to eat junior brother in front of me?" The monster did not deny it, but asked: "Is it really important to you?" More important than the chance of his own survival? The mummies will never let go of these Taoist priests, they are like Shadow follows him, always hiding in the dark, trying to seize everyone who comes out of the Taoist temple. The monster said: "You and they are enemies, and they are also enemies. If you help me, you are helping yourself." As for the junior brother, he is destined to die on this grassland. It is better to die in the mouth of the corpse. This truth should be easy to understand. The farmer raised his head silently and seemed to have figured it out. Walking towards the outside of the Taoist temple, he opened the door and faced the two mummies on the grassland. The monster smiled, opened its bloody mouth, and bit the boy's soul. It also turned around and climbed onto the stone statue. Streams of blood emerged from the top of the stone statue, flowing everywhere like springs, covering every part of the stone statue. The blood on the ground became thicker and thicker, accumulating more and more. The monster gradually shed its hair, shed its skin, and transformed. It turned into a dry corpse with no movement. "Sooner or later, one day." "Whether it's far or near, she will come back sooner or later." Dog barks echoed in the Taoist temple, and the stone statue whispered to itself: "Did the master say it?" Wrong, she will be back soon. "..." Bang~" Suddenly, the door of the Taoist temple was kicked open. The farmer took the lead and rushed into the door again. He shouted: "Junior brother, don't be afraid, senior brother is here to save you again. " He was not alone this time, and he also found two reinforcements. The half-dead stone statue suddenly froze, and he slowly raised his eyelids and saw a desperate guy and the two mummies outside the door. The dog-headed statue opened its mouth and made a deafening voice: "Don't you understand that you will definitely die in their hands?" "I understand." The farmer shrugged and smiled indifferently. Laughing: "But this is how the master arranged it. I am more obedient." "Besides, I hate people lying to me, even dogs." The dog-headed statue asked back, "What does this mean?" The farmer narrowed his eyes and asked: "Who are you, and where did you come from?" "I am the god of Zeguo, a priest consecrated by the great priest himself." "Go away." The farmer grinned: "Where did you come from, the great priest?" "This is me. You made it up to deceive your junior brother, and you acted it out with me?" The dog-headed statue suddenly fell silent. The farmer said word by word: "The real history of Zeguo is that these things in the Taoist temple are traitors." "It was greedy for life and feared death. It took the initiative to work as a lackey for the immortal and provoked other things." Where is this dog? Who is this dog? At this moment, it should not be difficult to guess? The dog-headed statue was quiet for a long time and suddenly smiled. It looked at the mummy and the Taoist priest and asked in a low voice: "I am a dog, but do you know whose dog I am?" The farmer raised his eyebrows and asked: "Who?" The dog-headed statue opened his mouth and said two words: "Mountain Master." The Taoist temple suddenly became quiet, and there was no sound. After a long time, the farmer raised his head and asked. "Who is the owner of the dog?" The master didn't say anything.
